نسترجم (form X)
# نَسْتَرْجِمُ (nastarjimu) /nas.tar.d͡ʒi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
# نَسْتَرْجِمَ (nastarjima) /nas.tar.d͡ʒi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
# نَسْتَرْجِمْ (nastarjim) /nas.tar.d͡ʒim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
